title: The Champ
selection_exposition:
Rico's life between the
events in D Block.<Close>
blocks:
CHAPTER 2
THE CHAMP<Close>

[Rico is undefeated. A
private room and Stier mark
his place in D Block.]<Close>

Hammer
Master Rico! News from the
infirmary.<Close>

<Rico>
You ran all the way up here.
Say it.<Close>

Hammer
The new prisoner is awake.
Fei Fong Wong. He can walk.<New>Hammer
Suzarn is bringing him over.
They say he piloted a Gear.<Close>

<Rico>
A pilot. We'll see how he
does without the machine.<Close>

Suzarn
Here he is, Champ.<Close>

<Rico>
Welcome to D Block, kid. You
got a name?<Close>

<Fei>
Fei Fong Wong. What is yours?<Close>

<Rico>
Let him ask, Suzarn. It's
Rico.<Close>

<Rico>
You live here now. We need to
know where you stand.<Close>

<Rico>
Call Heinrich, Vargas and
Leonardo. Take him outside.<New><Rico>
Begin the Baptism.<Close>

[In the following days,
Battlers begin disappearing
in the sewers.]<New>[Then the bodies are found.]<Close>

Hammer
They found another one below.
Five Battlers now.<New>Hammer
People are saying Fei did it.<Close>

<Rico>
My men set that trap in your
Gear. They meant to kill you.<New><Rico>
I'm sorry. Now they're dead,
and people suspect you.<New><Rico>
There's a story about a sewer
monster. I'm going to look.<Close>

<Fei>
Then I'm coming with you.
I'll prove I didn't do it.<Close>

<Rico>
Stay close. I know the way
down.<Close>

[Rico, Fei and Citan track a
creature through the sewers.]<New>[They defeat Redrum. Rico
leaves the fight with a
wounded arm.]<Close>

<Fei>
It's not moving. Why did it
come for that bell?<Close>

<Rico>
...We're done here. Let's get
out.<New><Rico>
We still have the Finals
ahead of us.<Close>

<Fei>
Your arm is bleeding. Let the
doctor see it.<Close>

<Rico>
Back at the rooms. And don't
hold back on my account.<Close>

<Fei>
All right. I'll not.<Close>

[Weltall drives Stier back.
Rico's last counter falls
short.]<New>[Fei Fong Wong wins the
Finals.]<Close>

<Fei>
Rico... can you get out?<Close>

<Rico>
I can. You beat me, Fei. No
excuses.<New><Rico>
They're calling for you. Go.<Close>

[Later, Rico returns to the
arena for the Group League
bouts.]<Close>

<Rico>
The Kaiser is still watching.<Close>

<Rico>
Sigmund...<Close>

[Stier turns away from the
bout and strikes the Kaiser's
box.]<New>[By the time the guards reach
the Gear, the cockpit is
empty.]<Close>

Hammer
Bro, the guards searched
Stier. Master Rico was not
inside.<New>Hammer
Rue is waiting for you
upstairs.<Close>

Rue
Fei, these rooms are yours
now. The bedroom is next
door.<New>Rue
You hold the title of
Champion and special Rank S
privileges.<Close>

Rue
Kaiser Sigmund wishes to meet
you.<New>Rue
Please report to the Central
District.<Close>

<Fei>
The Kaiser... All right. I'll
go.<Close>

<Rico>
Guards at every turn. I need
to get above the street.<Close>

<Rico>
They've opened the way for
Fei.<New><Rico>
There's an air duct above the
entrance. I can get through.<Close>

[Rico slips into the Central
District and looks for
somewhere to hide.]<Close>
CHAPTER 2 COMPLETE<Close>
